guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: tight high-gain Metallica chug with dark mid-scoop
tone.profile: tight high-gain Metallica chug with dark mid-scoop
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a Distortion pedal and the Recti amp model with a 4x12 cab to achieve a dark, scooped, percussive metal sound.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain metal tones.
Slightly boost the signal into the high-gain section for maximum punch and tightness.
blocks.gap: A dedicated overdrive pedal (like OD 9) might be used, but Boost is better for pure gain stacking without color.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary high-gain foundation and aggressive saturation for metal chugging.
blocks.gap: While RAT-style or Muff-style could work, 'Distortion' offers a more neutral, modern scooped tone suitable for Metallica's sound.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the massive, scooped, high-gain sound characteristic of Mesa/Boogie style amps.
Provide a solid, punchy platform for the high-gain tone while maintaining clarity.
blocks.gap: The 'Mess 4x12' might offer more grit, but 'UK Vintage 4x12' provides better definition for tight rhythm playing.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and boost bass/treble to achieve the dark, percussive metal sound.
Disabled. Chorus is avoided as per the musical verdict to maintain a dry, aggressive rhythm sound.
Disabled. Used only for occasional fills or atmospheric passages; kept off for pure rhythm chugging.
Add minimal ambient space to prevent the tone from sounding completely sterile, while keeping it dry and percussive.
blocks.gap: A smaller Room setting or Plate might be better for extreme dryness, but this provides necessary depth.

blocks.purpose: Final output level adjustment to match the desired performance volume.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better definition and tightness in the high-gain rhythm tone.

proposals.reason: Improve transient response and definition for tight chugging.
